title: Read Once, Answer Many: Parallel Prompting for Shared-Context LLM Inference
abstract: arXiv:2611.15130v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM workloads sometimes ask many independent questions about the same long document, as in document QA, data labeling and LLM-based evaluation. Prefix caching removes the redundant prefill shared by these queries, but each decode step still reads the document's key-value (KV) cache once per question, so decoding is bound by memory bandwidth and scales with the number of questions. We present Parallel Prompting, which decodes P questions as P independent streams of a single request all at once, fixing this issue. In our method, every step reads the shared document once for all P streams, and a stream-id attention mask, evaluated inside the attention kernel, keeps each answer conditioned only on the document and its own question. We implement Parallel Prompting in SGLang by adding about 80 lines to three existing files and a small engine package; the mask needs no dense tensor, and every decode step has a fixed shape that is captured as

translated_title: 一次读取，多次回答：面向共享上下文LLM推理的并行提示
translated_abstract: LLM工作负载有时会针对同一份长文档提出许多相互独立的问题，例如文档问答、数据标注和基于LLM的评估等场景。前缀缓存消除了这些查询共享的冗余预填充计算，但在解码阶段的每一步中，每个问题仍需读取一次文档的键值（KV）缓存，因此解码过程受内存带宽限制，开销随问题数量增加而线性增长。我们提出了并行提示方法，将P个问题作为单个请求的P个独立流同时解码，从而解决这一问题。在我们的方法中，每一步只需为所有P个流读取一次共享文档，而在注意力内核内部求值的流ID注意力掩码，确保每个答案仅以文档及其自身的问题为条件。我们在SGLang中实现了并行提示，仅需在三个现有文件中添加约80行代码以及一个小型引擎包；该掩码无需密集张量，且每个解码步骤具有固定形状，可以被捕获（为……）[原文摘要在此处截断]
tldr: 提出并行提示方法，将多个问题作为同一请求的独立流并行解码，每步只需读取一次共享文档的KV缓存，突破内存带宽瓶颈，使共享长上下文的多问题LLM推理不再随问题数量线性扩展。
en_tdlr: Parallel Prompting decodes P questions as P independent streams of a single request, reading the shared document's KV cache only once per step for all streams, eliminating the memory bandwidth bottleneck in shared-context LLM inference.
